spellbook.finance/limitations: Only an existing seller-selected profile can be activated. This operation never repairs a missing profile or generates a default.
The response reports resulting activeProfileId; it does not claim any marketplace already applied the profile.
Activation saves configuration and does not publish or trigger repricing.

description: Activate one seller-selected pricing profile and return its saved readback plus resulting active profile id. The first profile remains inactive until this explicit call. Activation does not publish or trigger repricing.

profileId.description: The exact saved pricing profile id from a prior pricing profile read. Required.

workspaceId.description: The workspace the seller selected. The caller must own it. Required.

name: spellbook_pricing_profile_activate
